card.name: Past outcomes after has/have in reports
card.fires_on: Mainly the verb after "has" or "have" (resulted, occurred) describing a reported past outcome in drug-label text. Also fires on a few nouns that name an outcome, such as arrest or dialysis.

modes.label: Perfect-tense outcome verb
modes.description: The verb right after has/have that reports an event that happened, such as resulted or occurred.
modes.example: Hemodialysis has often<< resulted>> in reversal of symptoms and recovery .

modes.label: Outcome noun in adverse-event text
modes.description: A noun naming a serious event in warnings, such as cardiac arrest or dialysis.

modes.description: The abbreviation PK in an interaction table.
modes.example: No effect on ganciclovir<< PK>> parameters observed Probenecid 5
